model_scope: Reuse the inference repository's pinned URDF and arm mapping. This local model is not asserted byte-identical to the login-protected Datasight model, nor calibrated to either camera.
tcp_definition: Nominal symmetric gripper center: link6 local point [0,0,0.13503] m, the common zero-opening origin of link7/link8. The reference midpoint differs by at most sub-micrometre roundoff from truncated URDF finger rotations.
gripper_handling: Use six measured arm joints only. Opening does not change the nominal symmetric gripper center; do not apply the reference command-unit gripper heuristic to measured widths.
